name: reader-ai-range-chat-example
description: Minimal Electron EPUB reader with START/END-scoped Codex chat

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n renderer,electron -c blue,green "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 45173 --strictPort" "wait-on tcp:45173 && npm run build:main && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:45173 electron ."
scripts.test: vitest run --root . tests/smoke.test.ts tests/app-ipc.test.ts tests/codex-launch.test.ts tests/dev-launch.test.ts tests/reading-range.test.ts tests/ui.test.tsx
